tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250sde brgyad bcos thabs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo//

gnas gtsang mar ri rab lha bshos/ so so'i bshos bu/ 'o phud/ me tog sna tshogs/ rtsi sman/ mngar gsum/ sha sna/ sman sna/ 'bru sna/ dar sna/ zas sna gang 'byor bshams la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang nyid yi dam gang byed bsgom la/ rdzas rnams sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis brlabs nas ting nge 'dzin gyis 'di skad do// hūm̐/ sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang*// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang*// mkha' 'gro nor lha chos srung sogs// mchod yul gong ma thams cad la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// lha yi dbang po brgya byin dang*// lha min dbang po thags bzang ris// mi 'am ci ljon rta mgo can// gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*// mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba dang*// srin po lang ka mgrin bcu dang*// chos skyong ma hā kā la dang*// dri za zur phud lnga pa sogs// phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// yab gcig bdud rje nag po dang*// btsan rgyal yam shud dmar po dang*// yul lha phya sangs klu sras dang*// srog bdag rgyal po snying 'byin dang*// chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar po dang*// lha mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang*// dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang*// dkar mo nyi zla thod phreng sogs// nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// bdud po kha thun raksha dang*// gshin rje gshed po dmar nag dang*// klu bdud nā ga rā dza dang*// gnod sbyin shan pa gri thogs dang*// ma mo srid pa khrom 'debs dang*// btsan po yam shud srog len dang*// bdud po re te 'go yag dang*// srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs sogs// gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la// dkar mchog khram shing kha 'thor dang*// bdud mchog ma nu raksha dang*// btsan mchog gri btsan 'thum po dang*// ma mchog ce spyang mdung 'dzin dang*// klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang*// mgon mchog nag po lte dkar dang*// rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs// mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// dpung g.yas dgra blar sprul pa dang*// dpung g.yon ma mor sprul pa dang*// chu so bdud du sprul pa dang*// mgo bo srin por sprul pa dang*// mjug ma dmu ru sprul pa dang*// lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul pa dang*// lag g.yon klu btsan sprul pa dang*// mig dang snying dang mtshan ma gsum// gza' bdud nyid du sprul pa sogs// sprul pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol// sa bdag hal khyi nag po dang*// klu bdud gdol pa nag po dang*// sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang*// phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang*// mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*// yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang*// pho lha dgra bla srog lha dang*// mo lha mo sman la sogs pa// snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la// mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo// gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la// bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//

ser ba bsrung ba/ sri'u gso ba/ mdos glud gtang ba/ zor 'phen pa la sogs las gang byed kyang*/ sngon du 'gro ba'i sde brgyad mchod pa 'di med na/ byis pas mkhar las byed pa dang 'dra zhes gsungs/ las gang gi yang sngon du 'gro ba sde brgyad bcos thabs gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/// /
